description: Custom role creation: name and capability validation, duplicate guard, built-in protection.

cases.inputs: Name: "Thư ký phó"; Description: "Hỗ trợ thư ký"; Capabilities: ["MeetingCreator", "MinutesEditor"].
cases.log: Role and its capabilities saved in one transaction; audit row RoleCreated (details { name, description, capabilities }); log "Role {RoleId} created by {ActorId}."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
No role is named "Thư ký phó".
cases.return: RoleResult Success (MSG19): custom role (not built-in) with 0 holders and capabilities MeetingCreator and MinutesEditor.

cases.inputs: Name: "Thư ký phó"; Description: null; Capabilities: [].
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
No role is named "Thư ký phó".
cases.return: RoleResult Success (MSG19): a role with no capabilities is allowed; description stored as null.

cases.inputs: Name: "  Thư   ký  phó  " (extra spaces); Description: "   " (blank).
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
cases.return: RoleResult Success (MSG19): the name is saved as "Thư ký phó" (trimmed, whitespace collapsed) and the blank description as null.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
cases.return: RoleResult InvalidInformation (MSG20) with errors[name] = "Tên vai trò không được để trống."; nothing saved.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
cases.return: RoleResult InvalidInformation (MSG20) with errors[name] = "Tên vai trò không được để trống.".

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
cases.return: RoleResult Success (MSG19): 64 characters is the maximum.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
cases.return: RoleResult InvalidInformation (MSG20) with errors[name] = "Tên vai trò không được vượt quá 64 ký tự.".

cases.inputs: Name: 60 Vietnamese letters typed as base letters plus combining marks (decomposed Unicode), more than 64 code points raw but 60 characters once composed.
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
cases.return: RoleResult Success (MSG19): the name is normalised to composed form before the 64-character limit is applied, and saved composed.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
cases.return: RoleResult InvalidInformation (MSG20) with errors[description] = "Mô tả không được vượt quá 256 ký tự.".

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
cases.return: RoleResult InvalidInformation (MSG20) with errors[capabilities] = "Quyền không hợp lệ: KhongTonTai."; nothing saved.

cases.inputs: Name valid; Capabilities: ["1", "99"] (numbers instead of names).
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
cases.return: RoleResult InvalidInformation (MSG20) with errors[capabilities] listing "1, 99": numeric strings are not accepted as capabilities.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
cases.return: RoleResult InvalidInformation (MSG20) with errors[capabilities] = "Quyền không hợp lệ: null.".

cases.log: Role saved with one MeetingCreator grant; audit row RoleCreated.
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
cases.return: RoleResult Success (MSG19): names match case-insensitively and the repeated capability is stored once.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
cases.return: RoleResult InvalidInformation (MSG20) with errors for name, description and capabilities at once.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
A custom role "Thư ký phó" exists.
cases.return: RoleResult Failure(DuplicateName) (MSG21): names are unique regardless of case; nothing saved.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
A built-in role "Quản trị viên" exists.
cases.return: RoleResult Failure(DuplicateName) (MSG21): a new role cannot take a built-in role name.

cases.log: Log "Role create rejected: name already taken (unique index)."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
The name is free when checked, but a concurrent request inserts the same name before this save.
cases.return: RoleResult Failure(DuplicateName) (MSG21): the unique index violation is answered like the duplicate check; no audit row.

cases.log: Error log "Role create failed to save."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
The database refuses the save (connection lost or timeout).
cases.return: RoleResult Failure(SaveFailed) (MSG26); no role is created and no audit row is written.

precondition: Capability catalogue available; no role with the test name exists.
